methyltfr_core

Source: R/methyltfr_core.R
methyltfr_core.Rd

Internal engine shared by runMethylTFR and runMethylTFRFromRnBeads. It validates the motif set, allocates the on-disk sinks, iterates over samples, computes per-motif deviations in chunks and assembles the resulting methylTFRdeviations object.

The only difference between the two public entry points is where the per-sample methylation calls come from. That difference is isolated in the msites_fun argument, so both entry points share identical numerical behaviour.

Usage

methyltfr_core(
  sample_ids,
  msites_fun,
  samples,
  tf_bindsites,
  gcfreqs,
  gc_dist,
  chunkSize = 20,
  threads = 1,
  enhancer = NULL,
  ignoreStrand = TRUE,
  tempDir = file.path(tempdir(), "methylTFR")
)

Arguments

sample_ids

A character vector of sample identifiers. Used for the column names of the resulting object and to size the sinks.

msites_fun

A function of a single integer i returning the methylation sites of sample i as a GRanges with the metadata columns score and coverage.

samples

A data.frame of sample annotation with one row per entry of sample_ids, used as colData.

tf_bindsites

A GRangesList named by motif. Each element is a GRanges of the occurrences of that motif. The names must include every name in names(gcfreqs). Get it with getTFbindsites(motifSet = "jaspar2020") from the methylTFRAnnotationHg38 (or methylTFRAnnotationMm10) package, or build a custom set with methylTFRAnnotationBuilder.

gcfreqs

A named list with one element per motif, named as in tf_bindsites. Each element is a numeric matrix with the five GC bins in rows and the positions across the binding-site window in columns. Get it with getGCfreq(motifSet = ...) from the annotation package.

gc_dist

A GRanges object of 30-bp genomic windows with an integer metadata column GC_bin (1 to 5). Get it with getGenomeGC() from the annotation package.

chunkSize

Number of motifs processed together in one block. Default 20.

threads

Number of workers used to process the motifs of a chunk in parallel. Default 1 (serial).

enhancer

An optional GRanges object of regions, for example distal regulatory elements. Binding sites outside these regions are dropped. Any region set imported as GRanges works, for example the ENCODE candidate cis-regulatory elements (SCREEN) read with rtracklayer::import(). Default NULL uses all binding sites.

ignoreStrand

Logical. If TRUE (default), strand is ignored when overlapping methylation sites with annotations.

tempDir

Directory for the temporary HDF5 files written during a run. Default is a folder under tempdir(). The files are deleted when the run finishes.

Value

a methylTFRdeviations object with bias-corrected deviations, row-wise Z-scores and expected deviations.
